Dex is an AI recruiter agent that helps you run your job search. Tell Dex your stack, seniority, and what you want to build. We will manage your applications and surface other opportunities that are a fit.

The role

The next generation of unmanned systems will be built from advanced composites. This company is industrialising their production, building the autonomous factories that mass-produce these critical materials. They're backed by leading investors who were early believers in some of the most impactful deep tech companies of the last decade.

As a founding software engineer, you'll build the operating system for these factories: Argos. This isn't a role where you're siloed in a feature team; you'll own problems end-to-end, from supply chain orchestration to real-time factory automation and digital twins. Expect full autonomy, direct impact on physical production, and no layers of PMs or QA between you and shipping code.

The work

Build Argos, the OS orchestrating everything from raw material to finished part, including supply chain, quoting, and pricing.
Develop Argos Sim for automated CAD, DFM, and mould generation and simulation, compressing design cycles.
Engineer the factory automation layer, streaming real-time equipment and sensor data into a 24/7 digital twin.
Work directly with hardware engineers in a new 36,000 sq ft facility, seeing your code impact physical production daily.

What You Bring

2+ years shipping production-grade code, with experience in TypeScript (frontend) and Python or Go (backend).
A track record of building and owning high-quality products at scale, ready to discuss your specific contributions.
You thrive on end-to-end problem ownership, making consequential decisions independently.
A strong desire to build for the physical world; experience with manufacturing, CAD, computational geometry, or 3D environments is a significant advantage.
Meet ITAR requirements: US citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual, or eligible for required authorisations.

Founding roles like this, at the intersection of AI, robotics, and advanced manufacturing, are rare and often hard to find. Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$104,000.00 - $143,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Role Responsibilities:

Design, prototype and develop software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices with limited complexity
Develop software documentation and test procedures
Troubleshoot software problems of limited difficulty
Communicate with internal customers for an understanding of project requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field, such as computer science, information management, software/system engineering, cyber security or mathematics 
Familiarity with the basic theories and concepts of software engineering
Proficiency in C/C++, .Net, C#

Preferred Qualifications:

1-2 years of related experience

Full time

Employee Type:

New College Grad

Travel:

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

jobs.title: Software Engineer- Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

At Anduril, our Battlespace Awareness Command and Control Software team specializes in solving complex, real-world problems through cutting-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Our work involves cutting-edge algorithms and high-performance software for multi-target tracking, data fusion, battle management, autonomous robotic control, and mission planning. We are currently seeking talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.

About The Job

We are looking to hire a Software Engineer to join our growing Battlespace Awareness team. In this role, you'll provide software engineering and development support for several of the team's core tools, and for candidates with an ML background, help stand up new ML infrastructure that improves how the team optimizes system parameters and detects performance regressions in CI.

Required Qualifications

Professional experience in one or more of Python, Rust, C++, or C, with a clear track record of using these languages professionally
Solid software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented programming, functional programming, and REST API design
Experience building low-latency or real-time software
Experience with software testing, including Robot Framework testing and integration test development
Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Claude or Codex) as part of your day-to-day workflow
Experience with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines
Machine learning background particularly in:
Hyperparameter optimization
Anomaly detection
Explainable ML (e.g., Bayesian ML)

Must be authorized to work in the United States
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

TypeScript or JavaScript, React, and/or NodeJS
Pytorch
Python FastAPI
CesiumJS
Experience with faster-than-real-time (FTRT) simulation
Experience building Slackbot integrations.
Master's, PhD, or 2–3+ years of professional experience in machine learning, especially model deployment

We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range

$165,000—$219,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Lendscore
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About The Team

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We apply machine learning to high-impact product challenges, working across product areas to develop solutions that create meaningful customer value.

We focus on credit, building models to the standards required in lending and supporting the next wave of cash-flow-based underwriting. We value technical expertise, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork, and we’re guided by Plaid’s principles of impact, growing together, openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow.

About The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Credit team, you’ll design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning solutions that support LendScore and the future of cash-flow-based underwriting. You’ll work across the full model lifecycle—from experimentation and offline training through production serving and monitoring—and partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to turn data and new modeling approaches into reliable systems.

In This Role, You Will

Develop and productionize AI and machine learning models, from offline training through online serving and ongoing monitoring.
Experiment with modeling approaches and strategies for credit use cases, balancing model performance with the requirements of lending environments.
Partner with engineering teams to ingest signals and build the systems needed to bring models into production.
Contribute to both 0-to-1 problems and the scaling and improvement of established solutions.
Collaborate with teams across Plaid to help define the machine learning roadmap.
Dive into data and use evidence-based analysis to guide day-to-day decisions.

What Excites You

Building products that can empower millions of people through well-known and emerging fintech applications.
Experimenting with modern machine learning techniques on meaningful credit and lending problems.
Working across the full lifecycle of machine learning systems, from exploration to production and ongoing improvement.
Taking on both greenfield challenges and opportunities to scale solutions that are already delivering value.
Joining a high-ownership, bottom-up team where your work can shape the roadmap and drive business impact.

What Excites Us

2+ years of experience training and serving AI or machine learning models in a production environment.
Experience in fintech lending and a strong understanding of how models are built and used in lending.
Experience building or working with data-intensive backend applications in large, distributed systems.
Ability to code and iterate independently using data infrastructure tools such as Python, Spark, Jupyter notebooks, and standard machine learning libraries.
A track record of taking ownership and driving projects to business impact.
Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
Master’s degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a closely related field.
Nice to have: Experience in data analytics or data engineering.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$124,000.00 - $171,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Applied Materials, Inc. is the global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually

every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels

and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials,

our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.

Applied Materials' Mechatronics team is searching for an experienced Core Development Engineer to

join our team! Our team develops the software and control algorithms for the control system of our

products, which includes the real-time control of devices such as robots, motors, generators, pumps,

flow controllers and sensors. Our work also includes creating algorithms to optimize motion and process

control, dynamic system modeling and simulation, the design of the user interface, data collection,

storage and analysis, machine learning and analytics, remote access and security.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, implement, and validate real-time control algorithms for robotics, motion control, and process automation systems
Develop mathematical/dynamic models representing static and dynamic behavior of complex mechatronic systems, and optimize models for deployment on embedded real-time targets.

3, Implement control algorithms in real-time software platforms with focus on performance, robustness, and maintainability.

Troubleshoot a variety of difficult software and controls problems. Design and implement bug fixes
Perform servo tuning and optimization to achieve precision, stability, throughput, and robustness targets.
Create software specifications and test plans for simulators, test benches or the lab.
Conduct experiments and servo tuning to evaluate control performance, precision, stability, and robustness
Prepare technical documentation, design reviews, validation reports, and customer presentations.
Support product qualification, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, software, systems, and product engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle

Technical Skills

Proficiency and professional experience in C and C++ is required.
Proficiency with Matlab, Python, or another scripting language is required.
Experience with robotics, motion control, or motor/servo control systems is required.
In addition, experience in programming in several of the following areas is desired:
Real-time Control
Embedded Programming
Multi-threading
CAN Bus, CANopen, and EtherCAT
Visual Studio
Simulink and Model-Based Design / Embedded Code Generation
Proficiency with classical and modern, linear and non-linear feedback control implementation

on real-world systems (PID control, state-space modeling, observer design, system

identification, servo tuning, feedforward control)

Experience with GIT and version control in software development
Solves problems in moderately difficult to complex situations
Analyzes possible solutions using technical experience, judgment and precedents
Experience with semiconductor capital equipment operation and/or design is preferable

Interpersonal Skills

Excellent written and oral communication skills
Works to build consensus

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in a related field, such as computer science, information management, software/system engineering, cyber security or mathematics 
2–4 years of related experience
Proficiency in C/C++, .Net, C#, Operating Systems, Networking principles, Algorithms, Multi-threading

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company
building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.
We’re a data company
helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.
And we’re an innovation company
accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:

Driven Waybuilders
. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.
Relentless Curiosity.
We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.
Smart Risk-Taking.
We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.
Fearless Ownership.
We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For:
We’re hiring AI-first Software Engineers (iOS) to build, evolve, and scale OPENLANE’s digital marketplace mobile experiences.
These roles are for engineers who already treat AI as a first-class development tool, not a novelty. You’ll use AI to move faster, ship higher-quality software, and reduce operational and development toil, while still applying strong engineering judgment, ownership, and systems thinking.
You’ll work on customer-facing wholesale marketplace apps, partnering closely with Product, Senior iOS engineers, Android, and backend teams.

AI is an accelerator. Engineering ownership still matters.

Why OPENLANE:
Work on real-time, high-value marketplace systems at scale
Be part of a major platform modernization and AI transformation
Use AI as a first-class development tool—not an experiment
Collaborate with experienced engineers, product leaders, and platform teams
Grow in an environment that values learning, ownership, and impact

You Are:
AI-forward.
You already use AI tools to enhance development speed, quality, and efficiency, and you continuously adapt as tooling evolves.
Product-minded.
You think beyond code and understand how technical decisions impact customers and business outcomes.
Ownership-driven.
You take responsibility for systems end-to-end, including reliability and operational health.
Technically curious.
You enjoy learning new technologies and thoughtfully evaluating emerging approaches.
Quality-focused.
You value clean, maintainable code, strong testing practices, and production-ready engineering standards.

You Bring:
Core Engineering Skills

Experience shipping production iOS features in a team codebase
Solid Swift and SwiftUI skills; willingness to navigate UIKit where it still exists
Comfort with CI, tests, and code review
Growing end-to-end ownership of features with guidance from Senior engineers

AI-First Mindset

Actively uses AI development tools (code copilots, AI debuggers, test generators)
Curious about applying AI to real customer and business problems
Able to critically evaluate AI outputs instead of blindly accepting them
Comfortable learning and adapting in a fast-changing tool landscape

Technical Experience

Swift; SwiftUI views and ViewModels
Basic networking and app architecture (MVVM or similar)
Familiarity with feature flags and mobile analytics
Unit and/or UI testing
Willingness to grow snapshot testing

You Will:
Implement iOS features primarily in modern SwiftUI across seller and buyer marketplace experiences
Ship flag-gated work; write unit/UI tests; meet dual-OS PR gate expectations with support
Use AI tools daily to accelerate coding, tests, and debugging—then verify before merge
Collaborate with Product/design; learn shared platform concerns under Senior guidance
Pair with Android counterparts on shared product behavior

How You’ll Use AI in This Role:
AI-assisted coding and refactoring
AI-generated test coverage and validation
AI-supported debugging and root-cause analysis
AI-assisted documentation and knowledge sharing
Applying AI tools to reduce repetitive work and increase engineering leverage

Who You Will Work With:
Reporting to an Engineering Manager (Mobile), this role collaborates closely with Product Managers, designers, backend and platform engineers, QA, Senior iOS engineers, and the sibling Android mobile team on a daily basis.

Must Have’s:
3+ years professional iOS development (or equivalent depth)
Proficiency in Swift
Experience building apps with SwiftUI
Experience shipping at least one App Store app
AI-first mindset and active use of AI development tools with critical evaluation of outputs
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have’s:
Snapshot testing experience
Exposure to SPM modules and shared UI component libraries
Marketplace / e-commerce mobile experience
Interest in growing into auth, flags, and analytics ownership over time
Familiarity with hybrid WebView surfaces

What We Offer:

Competitive pay

Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

Robust Employee Assistance Program

Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Annual Salary: $85,000.00 - $125,000.00 USD (Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Hybrid Cloud Platform Engineer
to join our rapidly growing, innovative team!

The Hybrid Cloud Platform Engineer will join a program providing User-facing and Data Center Services supporting an Intelligence Community customer. The team will work together to support innovative design, engineering, procurement, implementation, operations, sustainment, and disposal of user-facing and data center information technology (IT) services across multiple networks and security domains, at multiple locations worldwide, to support the IC mission.

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’s
Best Places to Work
every year since 2014
, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location:
Onsite in St. Louis, MO or Springfield, VA

Required Clearance:
TS/SCI with the ability to obtain and maintain a CI Polygraph.

Required Education And Certifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Programming, Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline. (Additional Education, Training, Certifications or Work Experience can be substituted in lieu of degree or work experience).
8140.01M IAT Level II certification.

Required Experience

5-8 years of development experience

Desired Skills

Experience deploying and managing Red Hat OpenShift in a cloud and/or vSphere environment.
Experience with Amazon Web Services.
Python, Shell scripting, Git.
Linux distributions: RHEL/RHCOS, CentOS.
CI/CD orchestration tools: GitLab CI, Jenkins.
Container technology: Docker, Kubernetes, and Cloud Native Computing Foundation ecosystem in general.

Responsibilities

O&M of existing Red Hat OpenShift environment across multiple security domains in both Cloud and data center (vSphere) environments.
Supports OpenShift operators and frameworks including Crossplane, Kyverno, RedHat GitOps.
Deploys OpenShift to new sites as they come online.
Works with internal and external teams to understand integration requirements and scale existing platforms to meet them.
Works with Security to ensure ongoing compliance and develop secure solutions.
Supports data services including RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elastic Stack.
Compiles detailed documentation.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $109,600 - $156,600. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact hr@valiantsolutions.com.

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$132,000.00 - $181,500.00

Location:

Chandler,AZ

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer with 4-6 years of experience in database development, performance optimization, and data-intensive applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Oracle and PostgreSQL databases, along with experience working with time-series databases such as KDB+/q. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining scalable database solutions that support high-volume transactional and analytical workloads.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain database solutions using Oracle and PostgreSQL.
Develop complex SQL queries, PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
Design and optimize database schemas, data models, and indexing strategies for performance and scalability.
Work with time-series databases such as KDB+ to store, process, and analyze large volumes of time-based data.
Monitor database performance and implement tuning strategies to improve query execution and system efficiency.
Troubleshoot database issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.
Develop and maintain data ingestion, ETL, and data synchronization processes.
Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate database solutions into enterprise applications.
Implement database security, backup, recovery, and high-availability solutions.
Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and production support activities.
Create and maintain technical documentation for database architectures and operational procedures.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
4-6 years of hands-on experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL databases.
Strong proficiency in SQL and database performance tuning.
Experience developing PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and database objects.
Experience with PostgreSQL administration, query optimization, indexing, and replication.
Experience working with time-series databases such as KDB+/q or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of relational database concepts, data modeling, and database design.
Experience with database migration, backup, recovery, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of Linux/Unix environments and scripting languages.
Familiarity with source control systems such as Git.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high-volume data processing and real-time analytics platforms.
Knowledge of distributed systems and scalable database architectures.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with data streaming technologies and messaging frameworks.
Experience supporting mission-critical enterprise applications.

Oracle Database
PostgreSQL
KDB+/q (Time-Series Database)
SQL & PL/SQL
Database Performance Tuning
Data Modeling
Query Optimization
Replication & High Availability
ETL/Data Integration
Linux/Unix
Git

Yes, 10% of the Time

No

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Summary

Join us in a key cloud engineering role where you will help build and support the platforms and services that power our business. Working alongside development, architecture, security and operations teams, you will improve platform reliability, enhance observability and champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices.

You will play a pivotal role in strengthening service resilience, improving performance, managing operational risk and ensuring the availability and scalability of our cloud capabilities through continuous improvement and technical innovation.

Responsibilities

Build, maintain and optimise deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps, ensuring consistent, reliable and secure software delivery.
Design, implement and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services to support secure, reliable and scalable application delivery.
Identify, analyse and resolve platform, infrastructure and deployment weaknesses, driving continuous improvement in reliability, performance and operational efficiency.
Develop and maintain complex PowerShell and Azure PowerShell (Az module) scripts to support platform administration, operational management and cloud service reliability.
Collaborate with architecture, development, security and operations teams to establish and promote the adoption of SRE practices, improving observability, monitoring, service reliability, incident management and operational excellence.
Deploy and support multi-tier Azure environments using OpenTofu modules, ensuring consistency across development, test and production environments.
Maintain and enhance engineering tooling that supports software delivery, platform operations, monitoring and service management.
Support the testing, validation and deployment of new platform capabilities, assessing operational impact and ensuring production readiness.
Participate in follow-the-sun on-call rotations, lead or contribute to blameless post-incident reviews, perform root cause analysis and implement measures to prevent recurring incidents.
Ensure cloud infrastructure, deployments and supporting platform services are secure, resilient, compliant and aligned with organisational standards and best practices.
Manage production deployments for Azure App Services, utilising deployment slots, swap operations and blue/green upgrade strategies to achieve zero-downtime releases.
Deploy, scale and manage containerised microservices using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps.
Configure and maintain Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights to establish and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets for business-critical applications.

#Remote

Essential

Education / Qualifications

Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure cloud services and infrastructure.
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent technologies.
Experience with containers, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure App Services.
Understanding of incident management, root cause analysis, service reliability metrics and continuous service improvement.
Experience with infrastructure as code technologies such as Terraform, OpenTofu or Scalr.
Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or similar.
Understanding of secure cloud engineering practices, deployment strategies and production readiness.

Desirable

Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Refold and MCP Gateway.
Experience with advanced cloud operations, platform resilience and service recovery strategies.
Knowledge of techniques for improving operational efficiency, reducing recurring incidents and strengthening service reliability.
Experience defining and applying SLIs, SLOs and error budgets in production environments.

jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Improves sustainment efforts for new enhancements and capabilities while maintaining operational applications and their authority to operate. Program supports research, development, testing, and evaluation based on customer requirements and agile processes, while assisting with intelligence missions and global integration efforts.

About The Role

Peraton's Defense Intelligence Solutions (DIS) business unit has a need for an experienced Front End Software Engineer
to support its SITE III DO contract charged with the orchestration, sustainment, and evolution of a portfolio of mission critical applications and services supporting a major Directorate within the U.S. Intelligence Community (IC). The SITE III DO contract is designed to establish and ensure a multi-discipline approach to requirements engineering, solutions engineering, scheduling, reliability, resiliency, services development, integration, test and evaluation, maintainability and analysis across the National apparatus of Defense Intelligence, Combatant Commands, supporting Partner Nations and other Federal Agencies to ensure timely and accurate Human Intelligence (HUMINT) collection, correlation and dissemination. Our support team applies best practices in architecture design, data science, cloud services, DevSecOps and platform integration to develop, sustain and continually evolve the global U.S. human intelligence apparatus and supporting partners. This role is fully on-site
in Indian Head, MD
.

The Front End Software Engineer
will be responsible for the following, but not limited to:

Designs, develops, documents, tests and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions.
Conducts multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software.
Determines computer user needs; analyzes system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls; prepares operating instructions; designs and develops compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems.
Ensures software standards are met.
Analyzes user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
Confers with systems analysts, engineers, programmers and others to design system and to obtain information on project limitations and capabilities, performance requirements and interfaces.
Designs, develops and modifies software systems, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcomes and consequences of design.
Coordinates software system installations and monitors equipment functioning to ensure specifications are met.

Specifically seeking Front End Developers
as follows:

Responsible for website design/layout, images, content, buttons, navigation and internal links.
Responsible for verifying that a website's visual front end is free of errors and looks exactly as designed.

Implementation must support multiple browser types and versions, be 508 compliant and perform for bandwidth disadvantaged users.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in an area relevant to the position with 12+ years of applicable experience OR a Master's degree in an area relevant to the position with 10+ years of applicable experience OR a Ph.D. in an area relevant to the position with 7+ years of applicable experience; an additional 4 years of applicable experience maybe considered in lieu of a degree.
Active TS/SCI or SCI eligibility and active polygraph or ability to obtain a polygraph
Experience with Javascript, Jquery, Angular, Bootstrap or some other UI framework
Experience with Spring Boot, Java
Building prototypes in HTML or PowerPoint
Strong troubleshooting skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, Agile environment
Fulltime work in a SCIF is required, but hours are flexible

Desired Qualifications

OpenShift, Keycloak, Wildfly
Material-UI
Jenkins, Git, Artifactory, CI/CD pipelines
Automated testing (JMeter, Selenium, Robot Framework)
Security+ or other IAT II/III level certification that is currently active
AWS experience
STIG hardening

Peraton offers enhanced benefits to employees working on this critical National Security program, which include heavily subsidized employee benefits coverage for you and your dependents, 25 days of PTO accrued annually up to a generous PTO cap and eligible to participate in an attractive bonus plan.

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

jobs.description:
Job DescriptionJob DescriptionJob Title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure/DevOpsLocation: Hoboken, NJDivision: Technology Department: Engineering About Us Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. We are the pioneers of Entropy Quantum Computing (EQC), utilizing open quantum systems to solve NP-hard optimization problems. The Company's portfolio offers unique capabilities in high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and remote sensing. Position Description We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and maintain the build and deployment pipeline for our full platform, including cloud APIs, message brokers, databases, and hardware controllers, on both cloud clusters and on-premise stacks. You will own the path from commit to running cluster: the CI pipelines that build and test, the container registry the artifacts land in, and the pipelines that deploy them, as well as the secrets infrastructure they authenticate against. Our installer runs in environments we don't administer, including air-gapped sites. Responsibilities Own GitLab CI across the platform: shared job templates, build and test stages, artifact publishing, and the release pipeline. Other engineers on the team add jobs for their own services. You set the conventions those jobs follow and keep the pipeline fast and trustworthy.Make builds reproducible. Pinned base images, deterministic dependency resolution, and artifact paths that agree between Makefile, Dockerfile, and pipeline definition. Own our container registry, including image promotion between environments, retention policy, and vulnerability scan gating in CI. Maintain and extend a Helmfile-based installer that deploys a multi-service stack (Vault, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Traefik, cert-manager, MongoDB, etc). Build automated testing for infrastructure code: chart rendering and linting in CI, ephemeral cluster deploys against a real chart set, and upgrade tests that catch breakage. Build Python tooling for configuration generation, template rendering, and post-install sanity checks. Make it idempotent and make its failures diagnosable.Operate Vault: policy scoping, init and unseal flows. Support internal customers for deployment and pipeline issues. Diagnose failed builds, broken local cluster setups, and chart changes that don't behave as expected. Support customer deployments in the field during business hours. Work with our support and solutions engineers on installer failures, upgrade issues, and environment-specific problems on clusters we don't administer. There is no after-hours on-call rotation for this role. Support upgrade paths. Charts must be safe to re-apply against a cluster carrying real customer data, including CRD lifecycle and StatefulSet volume behavior. Participate in code review as a reviewer. We expect findings to be demonstrated rather than asserted. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering experience. Hands-on CI/CD ownership with GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar. You have written and maintained pipelines, not only triggered them, and you have debugged a build that passes locally and fails on a runner. Proficiency in Python and/or Go. Solid Kubernetes fundamentals. You can read a rendered manifest and explain what a given chart value changes and what it will do on upgrade rather than install. Hands-on Helm experience authoring or substantially modifying charts, not only consuming them. Comfort in shell and Make. Docker fluency, including layer caching, multi-stage builds, and why an image that works on your laptop fails in a scan gate.Experience with a secrets manager (Vault preferred) beyond reading values out of it.Linux fluency, including container networking. Preferred Qualifications Container registry operations with Harbor, Artifactory, ECR, or similar, including auth flows, robot accounts, and image lifecycle policy. Air-gapped, on-premise, or otherwise restricted-network deployment experience, including moving artifacts across an air gap. Supply chain tooling: SBOM generation, image signing, provenance attestation. Message broker operations (RabbitMQ): queue topology, dead-lettering, and upgrade paths. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or equivalent demonstrated depth. No prior quantum computing background required. Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.Incumbent(s) in this position may be required to perform other duties and special assignments not specifically stated above. Statements outlined in this section are designated as essential job functions in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.

Work directly with hardware engineers in a new 36,000 sq ft facility, seeing your code impact physical production daily.

2+ years shipping production-grade code, with experience in TypeScript (frontend) and Python or Go (backend).
A track record of building and owning high-quality products at scale, ready to discuss your specific contributions.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure - San Francisco HQ
new_jobs.description:
About Orb

We’re a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We’re building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence.

Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you’ll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar.

For San Francisco Bay Area , New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. Our values, customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together are at the core of everything we do.

About The Role

As a member of the infrastructure team, you’ll play a key role in maintaining a high bar for reliability. Our customers depend on our systems being operational, as downtime can directly lead to lost revenue. You’ll be responsible for the infrastructure powering the entire product, from event ingestion, API services, alerting, invoicing, and everything in between.

In This Role You Will

Lead infrastructure resiliency efforts - recovery mechanisms, tenant isolation, load spike handling, etc
Improve observability and operability of our systems
Build performance-critical, user-facing infrastructure (eg. real-time event processing)
Plan scaling initiatives to handle large customer growth
Partner with other engineering teams to ensure we build reliable product features
Learn from a talented peer group, and share your expertise

About You

You think deeply about edge cases, failure modes, bottlenecks, etc
You have a knack for investigating and debugging tricky errors and performance issues
You enjoy building scalable infrastructure for a high-growth product
You can effectively mentor fellow engineers on best practices (observability, rollout strategies, risk mitigation, etc)
You have 3+ years of experience in software engineering, and you’ve worked in in the infrastructure domain for 2+ years

Orb’s Tech Stack

At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools and we encourage you to apply regardless.

Frontend: Typescript + React + Tailwind CSS
Backend: Python
Datastores: PostgreSQL + Clickhouse
Streaming Platforms: Kafka + Spark Streaming
Cloud Platform: AWS

Benefits

Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance
One Medical membership
Unlimited PTO plus an additional week off between Christmas and New Year’s
401k plan
16-week paid parental leave with equity vesting
Commuter stipend
Catered lunches in the office
Annual learning & development stipend
Meaningful equity in the form of stock options

Equal Opportunity Employer

We work with each other day in and day out, and strongly believe that building a diverse and inclusive team is key to our long-term goals and success as a company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$124,000.00 - $171,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Applied Materials, Inc. is the global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually

every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels

and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials,

our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.

Applied Materials’ Common Systems Software Department is searching for an experienced Software

Engineer to join our team! Our department develops the software for the control system of our

products, which includes the real-time control of devices such as robots, motors, generators, pumps,

flow controllers and sensors. Our work also includes creating algorithms to optimize the material

deposition and removal on an atomic scale, the design of the user interface, data collection, storage and

analysis, machine learning and analytics, remote access and security.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develops code for complex software projects
Troubleshoots a variety of difficult software problems. Designs and implements bug fixes
Designs and prototypes the user interface
Creates software specifications
Creates test plans for simulators, test benches or the lab
Develops software documentation
Interfaces with internal and external customers for requirement analysis, software

troubleshooting and project scheduling

Proficiency and professional experience in C and C++ is required.
In addition, experience in programming in several of the following areas is desired:
Real-time Control
Motion Control
Embedded Programming
Multi-threading
CAN Bus
C#, .NET
Visual Studio
Matlab
Solves problems in moderately difficult to complex situations
Analyzes possible solutions using technical experience, judgment and precedents
Takes a new perspective on existing solutions
Exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information

Interpersonal Skills

Excellent written and oral communication skills
Works to build consensus

Education:

Master’s Degree with 1 or more years of professional experience, or

Bachelor’s degree with 3 or more years of professional experience

Full time

Assignee / Regular

No

No

new_jobs.title: AI First iOS Software Engineer (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company
building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.
We’re a data company
helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.
And we’re an innovation company
accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:

Driven Waybuilders
. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.
Relentless Curiosity.
We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.
Smart Risk-Taking.
We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.
Fearless Ownership.
We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For:
We’re hiring AI-first Software Engineers (iOS) to build, evolve, and scale OPENLANE’s digital marketplace mobile experiences.
These roles are for engineers who already treat AI as a first-class development tool, not a novelty. You’ll use AI to move faster, ship higher-quality software, and reduce operational and development toil, while still applying strong engineering judgment, ownership, and systems thinking.
You’ll work on customer-facing wholesale marketplace apps, partnering closely with Product, Senior iOS engineers, Android, and backend teams.

AI is an accelerator. Engineering ownership still matters.

Why OPENLANE:
Work on real-time, high-value marketplace systems at scale
Be part of a major platform modernization and AI transformation
Use AI as a first-class development tool—not an experiment
Collaborate with experienced engineers, product leaders, and platform teams
Grow in an environment that values learning, ownership, and impact

You Are:
AI-forward.
You already use AI tools to enhance development speed, quality, and efficiency, and you continuously adapt as tooling evolves.
Product-minded.
You think beyond code and understand how technical decisions impact customers and business outcomes.
Ownership-driven.
You take responsibility for systems end-to-end, including reliability and operational health.
Technically curious.
You enjoy learning new technologies and thoughtfully evaluating emerging approaches.
Quality-focused.
You value clean, maintainable code, strong testing practices, and production-ready engineering standards.

You Bring:
Core Engineering Skills

Experience shipping production iOS features in a team codebase
Solid Swift and SwiftUI skills; willingness to navigate UIKit where it still exists
Comfort with CI, tests, and code review
Growing end-to-end ownership of features with guidance from Senior engineers

AI-First Mindset

Actively uses AI development tools (code copilots, AI debuggers, test generators)
Curious about applying AI to real customer and business problems
Able to critically evaluate AI outputs instead of blindly accepting them
Comfortable learning and adapting in a fast-changing tool landscape

Technical Experience

Swift; SwiftUI views and ViewModels
Basic networking and app architecture (MVVM or similar)
Familiarity with feature flags and mobile analytics
Unit and/or UI testing
Willingness to grow snapshot testing

You Will:
Implement iOS features primarily in modern SwiftUI across seller and buyer marketplace experiences
Ship flag-gated work; write unit/UI tests; meet dual-OS PR gate expectations with support
Use AI tools daily to accelerate coding, tests, and debugging—then verify before merge
Collaborate with Product/design; learn shared platform concerns under Senior guidance
Pair with Android counterparts on shared product behavior

How You’ll Use AI in This Role:
AI-assisted coding and refactoring
AI-generated test coverage and validation
AI-supported debugging and root-cause analysis
AI-assisted documentation and knowledge sharing
Applying AI tools to reduce repetitive work and increase engineering leverage

Who You Will Work With:
Reporting to an Engineering Manager (Mobile), this role collaborates closely with Product Managers, designers, backend and platform engineers, QA, Senior iOS engineers, and the sibling Android mobile team on a daily basis.

Must Have’s:
3+ years professional iOS development (or equivalent depth)
Proficiency in Swift
Experience building apps with SwiftUI
Experience shipping at least one App Store app
AI-first mindset and active use of AI development tools with critical evaluation of outputs
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have’s:
Snapshot testing experience
Exposure to SPM modules and shared UI component libraries
Marketplace / e-commerce mobile experience
Interest in growing into auth, flags, and analytics ownership over time
Familiarity with hybrid WebView surfaces

What We Offer:

Competitive pay

Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

Robust Employee Assistance Program

Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Compensation Range of

Annual Salary: $85,000.00 - $125,000.00 USD (Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

new_jobs.title: Hybrid Cloud Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Hybrid Cloud Platform Engineer
to join our rapidly growing, innovative team!

The Hybrid Cloud Platform Engineer will join a program providing User-facing and Data Center Services supporting an Intelligence Community customer. The team will work together to support innovative design, engineering, procurement, implementation, operations, sustainment, and disposal of user-facing and data center information technology (IT) services across multiple networks and security domains, at multiple locations worldwide, to support the IC mission.

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’s
Best Places to Work
every year since 2014
, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location:
Onsite in St. Louis, MO or Springfield, VA

Required Clearance:
TS/SCI with the ability to obtain and maintain a CI Polygraph.

Required Education And Certifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Programming, Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline. (Additional Education, Training, Certifications or Work Experience can be substituted in lieu of degree or work experience).
8140.01M IAT Level II certification.

Required Experience

5-8 years of development experience

Desired Skills

Experience deploying and managing Red Hat OpenShift in a cloud and/or vSphere environment.
Experience with Amazon Web Services.
Python, Shell scripting, Git.
Linux distributions: RHEL/RHCOS, CentOS.
CI/CD orchestration tools: GitLab CI, Jenkins.
Container technology: Docker, Kubernetes, and Cloud Native Computing Foundation ecosystem in general.

Responsibilities

O&M of existing Red Hat OpenShift environment across multiple security domains in both Cloud and data center (vSphere) environments.
Supports OpenShift operators and frameworks including Crossplane, Kyverno, RedHat GitOps.
Deploys OpenShift to new sites as they come online.
Works with internal and external teams to understand integration requirements and scale existing platforms to meet them.
Works with Security to ensure ongoing compliance and develop secure solutions.
Supports data services including RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elastic Stack.
Compiles detailed documentation.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays

Experience working with time-series databases such as KDB+/q or similar platforms.
