new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Summary

Join us in a key cloud engineering role where you will help build and support the platforms and services that power our business. Working alongside development, architecture, security and operations teams, you will improve platform reliability, enhance observability and champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices.

You will play a pivotal role in strengthening service resilience, improving performance, managing operational risk and ensuring the availability and scalability of our cloud capabilities through continuous improvement and technical innovation.

Responsibilities

Build, maintain and optimise deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps, ensuring consistent, reliable and secure software delivery.
Design, implement and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services to support secure, reliable and scalable application delivery.
Identify, analyse and resolve platform, infrastructure and deployment weaknesses, driving continuous improvement in reliability, performance and operational efficiency.
Develop and maintain complex PowerShell and Azure PowerShell (Az module) scripts to support platform administration, operational management and cloud service reliability.
Collaborate with architecture, development, security and operations teams to establish and promote the adoption of SRE practices, improving observability, monitoring, service reliability, incident management and operational excellence.
Deploy and support multi-tier Azure environments using OpenTofu modules, ensuring consistency across development, test and production environments.
Maintain and enhance engineering tooling that supports software delivery, platform operations, monitoring and service management.
Support the testing, validation and deployment of new platform capabilities, assessing operational impact and ensuring production readiness.
Participate in follow-the-sun on-call rotations, lead or contribute to blameless post-incident reviews, perform root cause analysis and implement measures to prevent recurring incidents.
Ensure cloud infrastructure, deployments and supporting platform services are secure, resilient, compliant and aligned with organisational standards and best practices.
Manage production deployments for Azure App Services, utilising deployment slots, swap operations and blue/green upgrade strategies to achieve zero-downtime releases.
Deploy, scale and manage containerised microservices using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps.
Configure and maintain Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights to establish and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets for business-critical applications.

#Remote

Essential

Education / Qualifications

Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure cloud services and infrastructure.
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent technologies.
Experience with containers, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure App Services.
Understanding of incident management, root cause analysis, service reliability metrics and continuous service improvement.
Experience with infrastructure as code technologies such as Terraform, OpenTofu or Scalr.
Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or similar.
Understanding of secure cloud engineering practices, deployment strategies and production readiness.

Desirable

Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Refold and MCP Gateway.
Experience with advanced cloud operations, platform resilience and service recovery strategies.
Knowledge of techniques for improving operational efficiency, reducing recurring incidents and strengthening service reliability.
Experience defining and applying SLIs, SLOs and error budgets in production environments.

About Octave

Octave provides mission-critical software that empowers organizations to make informed decisions across every stage of the asset lifecycle - Design, Build, Operate and Protect - where performance, safety, and reliability are non-negotiable and failure is not an option.

Turning complex operational data into actionable intelligence, Octave connects expertise, real-world conditions and enterprise-scale insight to improve performance, resilience and incident response where it matters most.

Octave has more than 7,000 employees in 45 countries. Learn more at octave.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

Why work for Octave?

All in. Always forward. That's the way we do things around here. We put trust in our people because we believe it's the best way to unleash potential, bring ideas to life, and keep moving ahead. Improves sustainment efforts for new enhancements and capabilities while maintaining operational applications and their authority to operate. to support its SITE III DO contract charged with the orchestration, sustainment, and evolution of a portfolio of mission critical applications and services supporting a major Directorate within the U.S. Intelligence Community (IC). in Indian Head, MD
.

new_jobs.description:
Job DescriptionJob DescriptionJob Title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure/DevOpsLocation: Hoboken, NJDivision: Technology Department: Engineering About Us Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. We are the pioneers of Entropy Quantum Computing (EQC), utilizing open quantum systems to solve NP-hard optimization problems. The Company's portfolio offers unique capabilities in high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and remote sensing. Position Description We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and maintain the build and deployment pipeline for our full platform, including cloud APIs, message brokers, databases, and hardware controllers, on both cloud clusters and on-premise stacks. You will own the path from commit to running cluster: the CI pipelines that build and test, the container registry the artifacts land in, and the pipelines that deploy them, as well as the secrets infrastructure they authenticate against. Our installer runs in environments we don't administer, including air-gapped sites. Responsibilities Own GitLab CI across the platform: shared job templates, build and test stages, artifact publishing, and the release pipeline. Other engineers on the team add jobs for their own services. You set the conventions those jobs follow and keep the pipeline fast and trustworthy.Make builds reproducible. Pinned base images, deterministic dependency resolution, and artifact paths that agree between Makefile, Dockerfile, and pipeline definition. Own our container registry, including image promotion between environments, retention policy, and vulnerability scan gating in CI. Maintain and extend a Helmfile-based installer that deploys a multi-service stack (Vault, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Traefik, cert-manager, MongoDB, etc). Build automated testing for infrastructure code: chart rendering and linting in CI, ephemeral cluster deploys against a real chart set, and upgrade tests that catch breakage. Build Python tooling for configuration generation, template rendering, and post-install sanity checks. Make it idempotent and make its failures diagnosable.Operate Vault: policy scoping, init and unseal flows. Support internal customers for deployment and pipeline issues. Diagnose failed builds, broken local cluster setups, and chart changes that don't behave as expected. Support customer deployments in the field during business hours. Work with our support and solutions engineers on installer failures, upgrade issues, and environment-specific problems on clusters we don't administer. There is no after-hours on-call rotation for this role. Support upgrade paths. Charts must be safe to re-apply against a cluster carrying real customer data, including CRD lifecycle and StatefulSet volume behavior. Participate in code review as a reviewer. We expect findings to be demonstrated rather than asserted. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering experience. Hands-on CI/CD ownership with GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar. You have written and maintained pipelines, not only triggered them, and you have debugged a build that passes locally and fails on a runner. Proficiency in Python and/or Go. Solid Kubernetes fundamentals. You can read a rendered manifest and explain what a given chart value changes and what it will do on upgrade rather than install. Hands-on Helm experience authoring or substantially modifying charts, not only consuming them. Comfort in shell and Make. Docker fluency, including layer caching, multi-stage builds, and why an image that works on your laptop fails in a scan gate.Experience with a secrets manager (Vault preferred) beyond reading values out of it.Linux fluency, including container networking. Preferred Qualifications Container registry operations with Harbor, Artifactory, ECR, or similar, including auth flows, robot accounts, and image lifecycle policy. Air-gapped, on-premise, or otherwise restricted-network deployment experience, including moving artifacts across an air gap. Supply chain tooling: SBOM generation, image signing, provenance attestation. Message broker operations (RabbitMQ): queue topology, dead-lettering, and upgrade paths. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or equivalent demonstrated depth. No prior quantum computing background required. Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.Incumbent(s) in this position may be required to perform other duties and special assignments not specifically stated above. Statements outlined in this section are designated as essential job functions in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.

new_jobs.description:
This employer is seeking a Senior Elastic Stack Data Integration Engineer to join their team. The role involves designing, building, and maintaining data ingestion pipelines for security information and event management (SIEM) systems.

The Role
• Architect, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for Elastic SIEM.
• Develop advanced pipeline logic for parsing, transforming, and enriching security telemetry.
• Optimize pipeline performance, resiliency, and scalability.
• Ensure reliable delivery of high-fidelity data to Elasticsearch.

What You'll Need
• Significant experience with Logstash architecture, patterns, and performance optimization.
• Strong understanding of network protocols, logging patterns, and data telemetry.
• Proficiency with Linux administration and system-level debugging.
• An active security clearance is required.

What's On Offer
• Annual salary of $140,000 – $160,000.
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
• Paid time off and retirement benefits.
• Opportunities for educational reimbursement.
